### What changed

- Added `src/core/project/threads.ts`
  - Append-only thread store at `~/.cedia/projects/<slug>/threads/<id>.jsonl`.
  - `ThreadStore` open/read/list/send/deliver/pending, thread IDs, titles, folds for sessions, handoffs, messages, delivered state, and results.

- Added `src/core/project/handoff.ts`
  - `HANDOFF_PROMPT`, `HANDOFF_NO_TOOLS`, `defaultHandoffAt`, and the context-token estimate.
  - Default handoff point is half the window, capped at 150k, and below long-context pricing.

- Added `src/core/tools/threads.ts`
  - `recall` searches earlier session tool calls, results, and messages, with regex-or-literal queries.
  - `threads`, `read_thread`, and `message_thread` operate on other project threads only. Messaging is `write_workspace`, so read-only sessions are denied.

- Updated `src/core/loop/run.ts`
  - Writer sessions hand off once context passes `handoffAt` and doubles its first reply.
  - Handoff notes are prose-only; tool calls during handoff are not run.
  - A second tool-call attempt abandons the handoff and the session continues.
  - Inbox messages are logged as reminders at turn boundaries and marked delivered.
  - Added `thread` session metadata and `handoff` result/turn-end support.

- Updated `src/clients/headless/main.ts`
  - Every writer run belongs to a thread.
  - `--thread` resumes the last session on the same model, or creates a new session from the latest note/result.
  - Handoff creates a new session with the task, note, recall tool, inherited writes, and done-gate evidence.
  - Added thread message inboxes and thread/session result fields.

- Updated `src/cli.ts`
  - Added `--handoff-at`, `--thread`, validation, usage text, and `cedia threads` list/show/send.

- Updated `src/core/types.ts`
  - Added thread metadata, handoff result/turn-end reasons, and result `thread`/`sessions` fields.
